title: Smoothing Splines
comment: Smoothing Splines — Smoothing splines define regularized least square whose solutions are sums of kernel functions (special case of reproducing Hilbert space). Linear interpolation and cubic splines are special cases. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smoothing_spline

title: Numerical Range
comment: Numerical Range — The numerical range of a matrix is the range of the Rayleigh quotient. It is a convex set enclosing the eigenvalues. This enclosing is tight for maximally "stable" (normal) matrices. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Numerical_range
alt_text: Numerical Range. The numerical range of a matrix is the range of the Rayleigh quotient. It is a convex set enclosing the eigenvalues. This enclosing is tight for maximally "stable" (normal) matrices.

title: Ising

title: Shapiro Ineq
comment: Shapiro Ineq — Classic reference: V. G. Drinfeld, A cyclic inequality, 1971. For n=2k<=12 and n=2k+1<=23, the optimal value of cyclic sums is n/2 (Shapiro's inequality). This paper proved that asymptotically, these sums gets smaller than n/2 by 1%. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shapiro_inequality

title: Assignement Pbm
comment: Assignement Pbm — The assignment problem is a combinatorial optimization problem which can be solved in log(n) n^3 operations. It is a special case of Optimal Transport. For the Euclidean distance cost, trajectories do not cross. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Assignment_problem
